rules.j4-coverage: All 30 selected files, all original census ids, exact current/historical witnesses and whole-file lexical closure.
rules.j4-pins: Immutable complete source mode/hash/bytes; no patch claimed for preserve/park.
rules.j4-ownership: Every declaration and assertion stays pinned; R22 full-suite parity remains pending.
rules.j4-receipts: One receipt per complete file, exact input metadata and explicit pending full-suite obligation.
rules.j4-search: Park dependencies retain exact pinned searches, proposed aliases, and P7-DOC-GAP-05.
rules.j4-review: Every admitted and judgment reject is independently reviewable.
rules.a-passage-agreement: All pairs of overlapping operation intervals on the same line/passage agree in admission and effective disposition; independent adjacent expressions have distinct source intervals.
rules.b-real-blocker: R12: no boilerplate dependency shared after quoted operands, paths, IDs and line numbers are normalized; copies join their source passage; serialized state rows use their accepted per-file input dependency.
rules.c-render-owner: Every generated source-copy reference/tuple derives its disposition from the exact source owner; a park cites an actually parked source owner.
rules.d-own-operand: Each admitted dynamic tuple has its exact document-yielding sub-expression pathOperand in its pinned passage; every rejection names a closed R5 nonDocumentUse category.
rules.e-retired-successor: Preserved retired decision citations carry a live successorNote with a real heading anchor.
rules.r11-plans-boundary: R11: an operation rooted only in plans/** is rejected as plans-report-artifact; trace pinned declarations and imported constants, not adjacent context.
rules.j5-uniform-history: Every docs/history comment pointer in all judgment records is admitted/preserved uniformly.
rules.j5-fixtures: In-memory fixtures and proven temporary-root joins reject uniformly.
rules.j5-successors: Every preserved retired decision basename has a verified successor note.
rules.j5-review-closure: L12-80 disposition changes and the retained ui-spec witness are exact.
rules.j5-review-delta: Only changed/added judgment files are listed as this-turn review obligations.
